changed.title: A single circuit lists the leading satisfying cyclic words with a gate budget additive in states and slots
changed.statement:
∀ (n m w slots : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), 0 < m → m ≤ n → slots ≤ 2 ^ n →
  let I := m * 2 ^ (w + 1)
  let d := min w (n - 1)
  let states := 2 ^ (d + (m + d - n))
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (valid : Fin slots → Fin (I + C.size)) (outBit : Fin slots → Fin n → Fin (I + C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack I C ∧ C.output < I + C.size ∧
    C.size ≤ 65536 * (n + 1) ^ 4 * (states + slots) ∧
    ∀ table : Fin m → (Fin (w + 1) → Bool) → Bool,
      let x := (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin m => List.ofFn (fun p : Fin (2 ^ (w + 1)) =>
        table i (fun j => p.val.testBit j.val)))).flatten
      let sols := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ n))).filter (fun z =>
        ∀ i : Fin m,
          table i (fun j => z.val.testBit (n - 1 - ((i.val + j.val) % n))) = true)
      (C.eval x = true ↔ sols.Nonempty) ∧
      ∀ t : Fin slots,
        ((C.wires x).getD (valid t).val false = true ↔ t.val < sols.card) ∧
        (t.val < sols.card → ∃ z ∈ sols,
          (sols.filter (fun y => y.val < z.val)).card = t.val ∧
          ∀ j : Fin n, (C.wires x).getD (outBit t j).val false =
            z.val.testBit (n - 1 - j.val))
changed.unlocks: recovers the leading passing words in physical-position order with a shared table across queries
changed.context: Read positions in order. Keep the last d bits and the initial e. Test ordinary windows on arrival and wrapping windows at the end. Compute suffix counts backwards at each state, keeping the zero-child count. Give each slot its rank as a residual. Read all zero-child counts in one batched lookup per layer. Choose zero if the residual is smaller. Otherwise choose one and subtract that count. Compare each rank with the root total to flag it. Gate-floor companions cannot exist for this construction giving an upper bound.

changed.title: Products of disjoint block monomials lose degree wherever a polynomial-query list predicts every coordinate
changed.statement:
∀ (m r c d L t : Nat), c < r → 0 < L → 0 < t →
  let V := Fin m × Fin r
  let W := V → Bool
  let par := fun (z : Nat) => z % 2 == 1
  let deg := fun (u : Nat) (f : W → Bool) =>
    ∃ terms : Finset (Finset V), (∀ mon ∈ terms, mon.card ≤ u) ∧
      ∀ word, f word = par ((terms.filter (fun mon => ∀ j ∈ mon, word j = true)).card)
  let productOn := fun (I : Finset (Fin m)) (x : W) =>
    decide (∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j : Fin r, x (i,j) = true)
  let run := fun (steps : Nat) (ask : Nat → Nat → W → Bool) (x : W) =>
    (List.range steps).foldl (fun past pos => past + ((ask pos past x).toNat <<< pos)) 0
  ∀ (budget : Fin d → Nat) (ask : Nat → Nat → W → Bool)
    (leaf : Nat → Fin L → Fin m → W → Bool),
    (∑ j : Fin d, budget j) < (r-c)*t →
    (∀ (u : Fin d) (path : Nat), deg (budget u) (ask u.val path)) →
    (∀ path a i, deg c (leaf path a i)) →
    let hit := (Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun sample =>
      ∃ a, ∀ i, leaf (run d ask sample) a i sample = decide (∀ v : Fin r, sample (i,v) = true))
    ∀ I : Finset (Fin m), I.card = L*t →
      ∃ q : W → Bool, deg (r*I.card-1) q ∧ ∀ x ∈ hit, q x = productOn I x
changed.unlocks: Lowers the degree of a selected block product on the entire list success set.
changed.context: Partition the selected blocks into L groups of t. On each leaf form a product with one factor per candidate, the true group product plus that candidate’s product of its t predictions. A hit makes this expression zero. Its leading term is the full true monomial. Every other term loses at least (r-c)t degrees. Multiply only the lower terms by their leaf indicators, of degree at most D, and add over leaves. Exactly one leaf indicator is one, so the sum replaces the leading term on every hit.

changed.title: Nonlinear raw-key questions for exact and partial recovery of guarded two-round outputs
changed.statement:
∀ (k : Nat), 0 < k → ∀ constant : Nat → Fin (2 ^ k),
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc cell =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit cell)
        (!(word.testBit ((cell + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((cell + 2) % k))).toNat <<< cell)) 0
  let state := fun (row rounds key : Nat) =>
    (List.range rounds).foldl (fun prev tick =>
      step (prev ^^^ rot 1 prev ^^^ rot (k - 1) prev) ^^^ rot (2 * tick) key ^^^
        (constant (tick + 1)).val) (rot 1 key ^^^ row)
  let injected := fun (round key pos : Nat) =>
    xor ((rot (2 * (round - 1)) key).testBit (pos % k))
      ((constant round).val.testBit (pos % k))
  let bit := fun (row round key pos : Nat) => (state row round key).testBit (pos % k)
  ∀ (m : Nat) (starts : Fin m → Nat),
  Function.Injective (fun z : Fin m × Fin 12 => (starts z.1+z.2.val)%k) →
  let good := fun (row ref : Fin (2^k)) (p : Nat) =>
    let old := fun (j : Nat) => bit row.val 0 ref.val (p+j)
    let first := fun (j : Nat) => bit row.val 1 ref.val (p+j)
    let τ := xor (xor (old 6) (old 7)) (old 8)
    let α := xor (xor (xor (old 5) (old 6)) (old 7)) (injected 1 ref.val (p+6))
    let β := xor τ (injected 1 ref.val (p+7))
    τ = false ∧ xor (xor (first 3) (first 4)) (first 5) = true ∧
      xor (first 4) (first 5) = !α ∧ first 4 = β
  ∀ (row ref : Fin (2^k)), (∀ i, good row ref (starts i)) →
  ∀ pin : Finset (Fin k),
  (∀ i (j : Fin 9), ∃ z ∈ pin, z.val = (starts i+j.val)%k) →
  (∀ i (j : Fin 3), ∀ z ∈ pin, z.val ≠ (starts i+9+j.val)%k) →
  let K := Fin (2^k)
  let bitOf := fun (q : K) (i : Fin k) => q.val.testBit i.val
  let par := fun (n : Nat) => n % 2 == 1
  let fiber := (Finset.univ : Finset K).filter (fun keyWord =>
    ∀ z ∈ pin, bit row.val 0 keyWord.val z.val = bit row.val 0 ref.val z.val)
  let deg := fun (u : Nat) (f : K → Bool) =>
    ∃ terms : Finset (Finset (Fin k)), (∀ mon ∈ terms, mon.card ≤ u) ∧
      ∀ key, f key = par ((terms.filter (fun mon => ∀ j ∈ mon, bitOf key j = true)).card)
  let run := fun (steps : Nat) (ask : Nat → Nat → K → Bool) (x : K) =>
    (List.range steps).foldl (fun past levelId => past + ((ask levelId past x).toNat <<< levelId)) 0
  let out := fun (input : K) (i : Fin m) => bit row.val 2 input.val (starts i+5)
  (∀ (b d L : Nat) (ask : Nat → Nat → K → Bool) (leaf : Nat → Fin L → Fin m → K → Bool),
    (∀ (u : Fin d) (path : Nat), deg b (ask u.val path)) →
    (∀ path a i, deg 2 (leaf path a i)) →
    let hit := fiber.filter (fun sample => ∃ a, ∀ i, leaf (run d ask sample) a i sample = out sample i)
    let count := (Finset.range (m+1)).sum (fun filled =>
      if filled < L*(b*d+1) then Nat.choose m filled * 7^(m-filled) else 0)
    8^m * hit.card ≤ fiber.card * count ∧
    (hit = fiber → m+1 ≤ L*2^d ∧ m < L*(b*d+1))) ∧
  ∀ a : Nat, 1 ≤ a → a ≤ 3 →
    let size := 2^a-1
    let steps := a*(m/size) + Nat.clog 2 (m%size+1)
    ∃ (choose : Nat → Nat → K → Bool) (pred : Nat → Fin m → K → Bool),
      (∀ (level : Fin steps) (path : Nat), deg (2^(a-1)) (choose level.val path)) ∧
      (∀ path i, deg 2 (pred path i)) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ fiber, ∀ i, pred (run steps choose x) i x = out x i
changed.unlocks: Bounds nonlinear raw-key decision trees for the physical guarded outputs and constructs a grouped decoder.
changed.context: Fix the exterior. In signed raw coordinates each output is a triple product plus an affine correction. Use t=bd+1 in the list degree identity and the binomial count. Flattening the tree yields at most L*2^d static candidates, so the odd-preimage argument gives the other floor. For the upper bound, group 2^a-1 triples and run the absent-prefix selector on a bits per triple. Pad a missing prefix to three bits. Add its point indicator to each triple product to cancel degree three. Use fewer bits for the final group.

changed.title: Finding an absent binary word with adaptive polynomial queries of bounded degree
changed.statement:
∀ (m r : Nat), m < 2^r →
  let V := Fin m × Fin r
  let W := V → Bool
  let par := fun (z : Nat) => z % 2 == 1
  let deg := fun (u : Nat) (f : W → Bool) =>
    ∃ terms : Finset (Finset V), (∀ mon ∈ terms, mon.card ≤ u) ∧
      ∀ word, f word = par ((terms.filter (fun mon => ∀ j ∈ mon, word j = true)).card)
  let run := fun (steps : Nat) (ask : Nat → Nat → W → Bool) (x : W) =>
    (List.range steps).foldl (fun past pos => past + ((ask pos past x).toNat <<< pos)) 0
  ∃ ask : Nat → Nat → W → Bool,
    (∀ (u : Fin r) (path : Nat), deg ((u.val+1)*2^(r-1-u.val)) (ask u.val path)) ∧
    ∀ (input : W) (l : Nat), l ≤ r →
      let trace := run l ask input
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter (fun i =>
        ∀ j : Fin r, j.val < l → input (i,j) = trace.testBit j.val)).card < 2^(r-l)
changed.unlocks: Selects a covering polynomial by computing a missing word from actual raw bits.
changed.context: If a reached prefix has fewer than 2u matches, let z count those continuing with zero, where u=2^(r-l). Ask the parity of the products of all u-element subsets of these zero-child indicators. This is choose(z,u) mod 2, the binary digit of z at u, so it tests z at least u on this branch. Pick child one if true and zero otherwise. The child has fewer than u matches. Each indicator multiplies l literals, giving degree at most lu even off the reached histories.

changed.title: A sharp binomial bound for sets where all products of k complete blocks agree with lower-degree polynomials
changed.statement:
∀ (m r k : Nat), 0 < r → 0 < k →
  let V := Fin m × Fin r
  let W := V → Bool
  let par := fun (z : Nat) => z % 2 == 1
  let deg := fun (u : Nat) (f : W → Bool) =>
    ∃ terms : Finset (Finset V), (∀ mon ∈ terms, mon.card ≤ u) ∧
      ∀ word, f word = par ((terms.filter (fun mon => ∀ j ∈ mon, word j = true)).card)
  let productOn := fun (I : Finset (Fin m)) (x : W) =>
    decide (∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j : Fin r, x (i,j) = true)
  let budget := (Finset.range (m+1)).sum (fun j =>
    if j < k then Nat.choose m j * (2^r-1)^(m-j) else 0)
  let lowers := fun (S : Finset W) => ∀ I : Finset (Fin m), I.card = k →
    ∃ q : W → Bool, deg (r*k-1) q ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, q x = productOn I x
  (∀ S : Finset W, lowers S → S.card ≤ budget) ∧
  let extremal := (Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun sample =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter (fun i => ∀ j : Fin r, sample (i,j) = true)).card < k)
  lowers extremal ∧ extremal.card = budget
changed.unlocks: Converts lower-degree identities for many whole blocks into a binomial count of successful inputs.
changed.context: In a squarefree monomial containing k complete blocks, extract their product, substitute its lower-degree representative on S, and multiply by the leftover variables. Every term has strictly smaller degree. Induct until the monomials contain at most k-1 complete blocks. They span every function on S, including point indicators. Count these monomials by choosing the complete blocks and a proper subset in each other block. On the stated extremal set the selected products all vanish.
